summary: Basel Medical Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with unaudited consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the six months ended December 31, 2024 and 2025. The filing contains no transaction or special situation—it is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. The report is limited to financial disclosure and regulatory compliance.
